recent.text: Sasha Barkov was back on a familiar line while Brad Marchand joined a new-looking trio. We’ll see if either or both can crack the lineup tomorrow. Paul Maurice: “They have to get through medical clearance today and then we’ll make a decision tomorrow based on that information.”

recent.quoted_text: As the #FlaPanthers prepare to host #GoSensGo on Wednesday, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand were full participants in practice. Find out who they were skating with on @TheHockeyNews https://t.co/XYYSkWKvy0

recent.text: Maurice happy with how Barkov and Marchand got through practice today. Still need to be cleared for tomorrow, but sounds like either one or both could suit up vs. Senators. Timelines are now pretty lined up for both guys, per Coach.

recent.text: Paul Maurice says both Barkov and Marchand still have to be cleared by docs after today’s practice but both came off the ice a little earlier than usual. All signs point toward a return tomorrow.
